svg.title: The rising floor: data-center regions add nearly as many MW at night as in the afternoon

cc:Work.dc:title: The rising floor: data-center regions add nearly as many MW at night as in the afternoon
cc:Work.dc:description: Six line charts of night vs afternoon weather-adjusted demand. Dominion adds 3,236 MW at night and 3,227 MW in the afternoon; its comparison region barely moves.
